name: BICS

energy.label: BICS PLC and drives
energy.isolation: Lock disconnect BICS-5 on the BICS cabinet.
energy.verify: HMI dark. Meter drive leads.

energy.label: Gate / clamp air
energy.isolation: Lock and dump air supply.
energy.verify: Gates free. Gauge at 0.

energy.label: Infeed motion
energy.isolation: Chock moving elements. Wait for coast-down.
energy.verify: No motion on jog attempt.

lockout.title: Hold Press 5 billet flow
lockout.detail: Tell the press and billet-heater operators.

lockout.title: Abort the active sequence
lockout.detail: Park gates in the safe position from the HMI, then local stop.

lockout.title: Lock BICS-5 and air
lockout.detail: Disconnect OFF. Air dumped. Tag both.

lockout.title: Verify zero energy
lockout.detail: Attempt sequence start and jog. Nothing moves.

inspect.title: Guards and light curtains
inspect.detail: Curtains clear. Interlocks functional.

inspect.title: Sensors and E-stops
inspect.detail: E-stops latch. Sensors clean.

restart.title: Area clear, restore air then electric
restart.detail: Run the empty homing sequence before production billets.

emergency.estop: Local mushroom at the drive; Press 5 line pull-cord
emergency.fire: ABC extinguisher on the Press 5 aisle

notes: BICS can auto-index on some faults — LOTO the disconnect, not just the HMI stop.

name: Billet Heater

energy.label: 480 V power and controls
energy.isolation: Lock disconnect BLH-5.
energy.verify: Panel dark. Meter load-side lugs.

energy.label: Natural gas (if gas-fired zones)
energy.isolation: Close and lock gas cock. Bleed per diagram.
energy.verify: Gauges at 0. LEL < 10%.

energy.label: Hot billets and coil / chamber
energy.isolation: Cool-down or treat every surface as hot.
energy.verify: Pyrometer below posted limit or work as hot.

energy.label: Billet conveyor / pusher
energy.isolation: Lock conveyor drive. Chock billets.
energy.verify: Pusher does not jog. Billets chocked.

lockout.title: Notify Press 5 — press will starve
lockout.detail: Tell the supervisor before taking the heater down.

lockout.title: Stop heat and clear billets if safe
lockout.detail: Do not reach into a live chamber for a stuck billet.

lockout.title: Lock electric, gas, and conveyor
lockout.detail: All isolation points get your lock.

lockout.title: Cool or work as hot
lockout.detail: Follow posted cool-down. FR and face shield for hot work.

lockout.title: Verify zero energy
lockout.detail: Attempt start. No heat, no motion, gauges at 0.

inspect.title: Guards and interlocks
inspect.detail: Doors / covers interlocked.

inspect.title: Thermocouples and high-limit
inspect.detail: High-limit tag current.

restart.title: Restore gas/electric per BMS
restart.detail: Purge if required. Do not bypass purge.

restart.title: Bump conveyor empty

name: Extrusion Press

energy.label: 480 V main pumps and controls
energy.isolation: Open and lock disconnect PRS-5 on the west MCC. Apply personal lock and tag.
energy.verify: Meter pump starter T-leads. HMI dark. Confirm 0 V.

energy.label: Main ram and container hydraulics
energy.isolation: Close and lock pump suction valves. Bleed cylinder circuits per the posted diagram.
energy.verify: System gauges at 0 PSI. Ram does not drift.

energy.label: Container / stem weight
energy.isolation: Set factory safety blocks / pins before entering the die area.
energy.verify: Blocks seated and pinned. Stem resting on blocks.

energy.label: Hot billet and tooling
energy.isolation: Cool tooling or treat as hot. Face shield and FR required near the die.
energy.verify: Pyrometer or gloved check before handling tooling.

hazards.title: Ram / container crush
hazards.injury: Fatal crush at the die or container

lockout.title: Notify Press 5
lockout.detail: Tell the Press 5 supervisor and clear the cell. Post the LOTO board at the operator stand.

lockout.title: Stop the press and park tooling
lockout.detail: Normal stop. Park the container and stem per the posted park sequence. Never crawl under a hanging load.

lockout.title: E-stop, then lock PRS-5
lockout.detail: Hit E-stop. Open the MCC disconnect. One lock per person on the hasp.

lockout.title: Dump hydraulic pressure
lockout.detail: Lock suction valves. Bleed slowly with face turned away. Catch oil in a pan.

lockout.title: Install safety blocks
lockout.detail: Pin factory blocks before any die or container work.

lockout.title: Verify zero energy
lockout.detail: Attempt a cycle from the HMI and palm buttons. Nothing moves. Gauges at 0.

inspect.title: Guards and light curtains
inspect.detail: Curtains clear. Interlocks kill motion when open.

inspect.title: Die clamps and tooling
inspect.detail: Clamps tight. No cracked bolts. Die set matches the job card.

inspect.title: Hoses and fittings
inspect.detail: No weeping at glands or hose crimps.

restart.title: Area clear, blocks removed last
restart.detail: Nobody in the point of operation. Restore hydraulics, inch clear, then pull safety blocks.

restart.title: Inch through one stroke
restart.detail: Single-stroke / jog mode. Watch for interference before production speed.
restart.warn: First stroke after a die change is the most dangerous. Go slow.

emergency.estop: Red palms both sides of the operator stand; overhead pull-cord
emergency.fire: ABC extinguisher at Bay column B

notes: Die changes require a second qualified person.
Never use the ram as a crane.

name: Age Oven 1&2

energy.label: 480 V 3-phase fans, elements, and controls
energy.isolation: Disconnect SHP-12. Apply your lock and tag.
energy.verify: Control panel dark. Meter load-side lugs. Circulation fans do not bump.

energy.label: Natural gas burner train
energy.isolation: Close and lock gas cock GAS-12. Bleed the train per the posted diagram.
energy.verify: Both gas-train gauges at 0. Combustible-gas meter at the burner < 10% LEL.

energy.label: Oven chamber ~350–400 °F during age
energy.isolation: Run the posted cool-down. Do not enter or reach into the chamber until the pyrometer is below the cool-to-touch limit, or treat every surface as hot.
energy.verify: Chamber pyrometer below the posted number. Racks cool to a gloved hand, or work as hot.

hazards.title: Hot racks and profiles
hazards.injury: Severe burns from loads and oven walls

hazards.title: Gas ignition
hazards.injury: Fire or flash in the burner / chamber

hazards.title: Walk-in chamber
hazards.injury: Heat stress, asphyxiation if the oven is entered

lockout.title: Notify Shipping 1
lockout.detail: Tell the Shipping 1 lead and the load crew. Ovens 1 and 2 share this card — both come down together.

lockout.title: Stop the age cycle from the HMI
lockout.detail: Do not open the door on a live cycle. Abort or wait for the soak to finish, then local stop.

lockout.title: Lock electrical and gas
lockout.detail: Disconnect SHP-12 OFF. Gas cock GAS-12 closed. One lock per person on each hasp. Lock both oven disconnects on the SHP-12 hasp.
lockout.warn: These ovens can auto-restart on a temperature fault. A dark screen is not isolation.

lockout.title: Cool down or work as hot
lockout.detail: Follow the cool-down on the door. Pull loads only with face shield and FR. Never step into the chamber to chase a stuck stick.
lockout.warn: Entering the oven is a permit-required confined space.

lockout.title: Verify zero energy
lockout.detail: Attempt a cycle start. Fans still. Burner does not light. Gas gauges at 0.

inspect.title: Door latches and seals
inspect.detail: Doors latch fully. Gasket not torn. Interlock kills the burners when a door is open.

inspect.title: Load carts and stops
inspect.detail: Carts on the track. Wheel stops in. No profile hanging off the rack.

inspect.title: Burner and relief
inspect.detail: No gas odor. Relief and stack clear. High-limit tag current.

restart.title: People out, doors latched, loads set
restart.detail: Nobody in the chamber or on the track. Confirm the age recipe on the HMI.

restart.title: Restore gas, then electric
restart.detail: Open the gas cock, then the disconnect. Purge per the burner management system. Do not bypass the purge.

emergency.estop: Red mushrooms on the SHP-12 cabinet and on each oven door frame
emergency.fire: ABC extinguisher at the oven aisle; pull station at the dock door

notes: Ovens 1 and 2 share a gas train. Isolating this card kills fuel to both chambers.
Call the Shipping 1 lead before taking a paired oven down — the other door may still be in cycle.
permits: Confined space if entering the chamber
